# braintrust_group (Resource)

Manages a Braintrust group. Groups are collections of users that can be assigned permissions via ACLs. Groups can also inherit from other groups.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Look up users by email so we do not hardcode UUIDs.
data "braintrust_user" "alice" {
  email = "alice@example.com"
}

data "braintrust_user" "bob" {
  email = "bob@example.com"
}

# Create a group for the ML team.
resource "braintrust_group" "ml_team" {
  name        = "ML Team"
  description = "Machine learning engineers"
  member_users = [
    data.braintrust_user.alice.id,
    data.braintrust_user.bob.id,
  ]
}

# Create a group that inherits from another group
resource "braintrust_group" "ml_leads" {
  name        = "ML Leads"
  description = "ML team leads - inherits all ML Team members"
  member_groups = [
    braintrust_group.ml_team.id,
  ]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name of the group. Must be unique within the organization.

### Optional

- `description` (String) Textual description of the group.
- `member_groups` (Set of String) IDs of groups this group inherits from. An inheriting group has all the users of its member groups.
- `member_users` (Set of String) IDs of users in this group.

### Read-Only

- `created` (String) Date of group creation.
- `deleted_at` (String) Date of group deletion, or null if the group is still active.
- `id` (String) Unique identifier for the group (UUID).
- `org_id` (String) Organization the group belongs to.
- `user_id` (String) Identifies the user who created the group.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import by the group ID.
terraform import braintrust_group.example 00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000
```
